input: frozen v1 ordinary Visium section manifest
score_algorithm: frozen rank on all same-section genes, including zeros; mean tie rank; K=ceil(0.05*genes)
P95: linear sample quantile .95 on D_MP10 per section, >= threshold, ties included; same single column for both boundaries
geometry: same block, same side connected component, observed finite hex segments only; strict if observed contact strictly closer than missing contact; border_spot_distance supplementary
component_weights: min(nB1,nB2); at least 3 each per component and combined >=20 per band
exposure: tumor-source sections' D_MP10 median, equal-weight section mean per mapped unit, dataset median; explicit ties
primary_family: two boundaries x three direct architecture contrasts on native continuous D; planned BH family=6
